left.raw_text: 1. Peritonitis or recovery from peritonitis for less than one month.

right.raw_text: 2. On any intra peritoneal treatment apart from peritoneal dialysis.

left.raw_text: 3. Evidence of decompensated liver cirrhosis or heart failure.

right.raw_text: 4. Evidence of extra peritoneal leakage, eg. leakage to thoracic cavity, post peritoneal, hernia.
